topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: The rain hits the window, each drop a reminder. I stare at the paper, the words staring back, cold and accusing. They say it’s a coincidence, a sample essay, just an example. But I know better. In this city, there’s nothing but angles and shadows, and everyone's got a hand in the game. Now, my words are out there, floating, and I can practically hear the whispers. They say the game is rigged, but I always knew that. What I didn’t know was how much it would cost. The night is long, and the rain keeps falling, but I can’t afford to stay still. There’s a job to do, and a city full of shadows to cut through.
